long_biography.plain_text:
Active restructuring defines Alexander Studhalter's approach to investment. He targets businesses where his team can work beside management, improve operations and realise underused potential. That method informs Studhalter International Group's private-equity arm, which has allocated capital to media, sport and event businesses.

The Lucerne organisation also owns income-producing commercial and residential properties alongside developments intended for sale after improvement. Its advisory business provides multi-client family-office and financial services. Swiss registry notices identify Studhalter as the parent company's board president with individual signing authority, combining strategic investment with formal control of the group.
